qualification: strict document-body projection only; no whole-corpus or legal-state claim

scope.model_header_rule: append a period to a bare section-sign number, then require exact source equality
scope.outside_body: excluded; original metadata remains in retained raw XML
scope.projection: complete documentBody text, ordered lists and containers
scope.unrepresented_named_nodes: data-name on legalP, listArticle and section is rejected
scope.whitespace: collapse HTML ASCII whitespace only; preserve Unicode and punctuation
scope.wrapper_policy: typed header spans and listArticle wrappers preserve ordered text; wrapper identity is not projected
